body:
<!-- gitissue:normalized v1 -->

## Type

feature (high confidence)

## Description

Add a new kind of benchmark for "System One" model endpoints, focused mainly on measuring **speed** and **accuracy** so candidate models can be compared on both axes.

Candidate models called out by the reporter:

- https://huggingface.co/bespokelabs/Bespoke-Nimble-9B
- https://huggingface.co/convaiinnovations/laya

**Related components:**
System One model endpoints; candidate models `bespokelabs/Bespoke-Nimble-9B`, `convaiinnovations/laya`

**Related issues:**
None identified

> **Reporter Context**
> generate new kind of benchmark for System One Model end point, focusing mainly on measuring the speed, and accuracy.
> Here is an example of candiate to be benchmarked: https://huggingface.co/bespokelabs/Bespoke-Nimble-9B
> and this one: https://huggingface.co/convaiinnovations/laya

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A benchmark targeting System One model endpoints exists and runs against a serving endpoint (high confidence)
- [ ] The benchmark measures and reports speed for each model under test (high confidence)
- [ ] The benchmark measures and reports accuracy for each model under test (high confidence)
- [ ] Results allow candidate models to be compared on speed and accuracy together (medium confidence)
- [ ] The benchmark can be exercised on the reporter's example candidates: `bespokelabs/Bespoke-Nimble-9B` and `convaiinnovations/laya` (high confidence)

## Metadata

**Priority:** P2 (needs review)
**Effort:** L (medium confidence)
**Suggested model:** GPT-5.6 Sol Extra High · Opus 5 Extra High _(CursorBench 3.2, 2026-09-02 — advisory)_
**Labels:** feature (medium confidence)
title: Add System One model endpoint benchmark measuring speed and accuracy
